payload.claim: Criterion 3 ('A cell driven through run_one_cell's default emit still prints the lines its events.jsonl replays, for events under BOUND_CHARS') is witnessed only by tests/test_events.py::test_events_jsonl_reproduces_what_the_terminal_printed, a preserves witness whose golden fixture carries no credential. Reverting line 136 back to the pre-spec order (print describe(event) before log.append(event)) still makes that witness pass, because with no credential present redaction is a no-op and the printed text equals the stored text either way. The actual regression this line guards against — a credential reaching the terminal before the log redacts it — is caught only by criterion 1's witness (tests/test_credentials.py::test_the_default_emitters_line_carries_no_credential), not by criterion 3's own assigned witness. Criterion 3's witness therefore does not, on its own, prove the fix at this line.
